topic.instructions: What is the main subject of the app review in `item.text`?

criteria.bug: Something in the app crashes, freezes, loses data, or does not work as intended
criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, trials, subscriptions, or price changes
criteria.performance: Slowness, battery drain, or storage use, with features otherwise working
criteria.feature_request: Asks for a feature, setting, or change the app does not offer
criteria.praise: Praise or general satisfaction with no problem or request
criteria.none: None of the listed subjects fits the review

needs_reply.instructions: Does the review in `item.text` report a specific problem that a support agent could investigate or fix for this reviewer?

criteria.true: A concrete failure, lost data, a login problem, or a billing error affecting this reviewer
criteria.false: Praise, a feature request, a vague opinion, or a general complaint about price or design

severity.instructions: How much does the problem described in `item.text` stop the reviewer from using the app?
criteria: No problem is reported; the review is praise, a question, or a feature request
A minor annoyance; the reviewer can still do everything they need
A feature the reviewer relies on is broken, slow, or unreliable
The reviewer cannot use the app, lost data, or was charged wrongly
